plan.reason: With only 24 of 100 evaluations used in a 10-D problem and 6 stagnated steps with zero recent improvement, boosting exploration and local search helps escape the plateau. Auto surrogate adapts via held-out RMSE among RBF/quadratic. current_to_best balances convergence toward the surrogate optimum with diversity; moderate mutation and high crossover maintain sampling. A modest population/generation count limits surrogate overhead so more of the fixed budget goes to true evaluations, while exploration 0.35 and radius 0.15 balance novelty-driven exploration against exploitation.
